name: Outreach Console
description: Private publishing workspace for LinkedIn, X, Instagram and TikTok: durable media uploads, per-platform drafts, calendar, scheduling and approvals; outreach messaging and email tools remain available.

requirements.name: OUTREACH_API_URL
requirements.description: Engine API base URL: local loopback (http://127.0.0.1:8787) or private Daytona preview HTTPS URL.

requirements.name: OUTREACH_API_TOKEN
requirements.description: Token from `outreach token create <principal> --role approver` (viewer for read-only).

requirements.name: OUTREACH_DAYTONA_LIVE_VIEW_URL
requirements.description: Optional Daytona Chrome live-view / VNC URL for social reconnect (ADR 0006).

requirements.name: OUTREACH_PREVIEW_TOKEN
requirements.description: Daytona private preview token. Separate from engine API token; kept server-side.

requirements.name: OUTREACH_CONNECTION_FILE
requirements.description: Absolute owner-only connection JSON file. Read on every action so runtime renewals take effect.

requirements.name: OUTREACH_DAYTONA_API_KEY
requirements.description: Optional server-owned Daytona key used only to renew private browser access.

requirements.name: OUTREACH_DAYTONA_REFRESH_PYTHON
requirements.description: Optional trusted Python executable with the Daytona SDK for local signed-view renewal.

requirements.name: OUTREACH_DAYTONA_CLI_AUTH
requirements.description: Set to 1 to explicitly reuse the server owner's selected Daytona CLI login during renewal.

app.name: Outreach Console
app.description: Compose, upload, preview, schedule and approve posts across four platforms.

deploymentProfiles.name: Desktop pilot
deploymentProfiles.notes: Desktop-only pilot. Keep publishing disabled. Configure absolute OUTREACH_CLI_ENTRY and OUTREACH_DB in the job environment; verify the job executes locally before enabling its schedule.
